text:
alex: heads-up — noticed a p50->p99 token latency spike on /v1/stream after the kernel-selector refactor this morning. SM occupancy on a subset of nodes dropped from ~88% to ~52%. anyone else seeing this?
sam: yup saw the alert at 08:14. started collecting perf traces. looks correlated with canary hosts in us-west-2.
jun: grabbing prometheus slices now, but quick question — did the refactor change fallback ordering? could be falling back to a slower gemm path for small batches.
maria: kv cache miss rate jumped at the same time for those routes. `kv_cache.miss_rate` from 0.12 -> 0.46 around 08:12. could be unrelated but worth checking.
perf-bot: Regression suspicion score: 0.72. Top suspects: kernel selector change -> increased fallback to `gemm_generic`. Noted elevated `kernel_latency` variance.
alex: here's a quick promql I'm running to map occupancy by host:```promql
avg_over_time(nv_gpu_sm_occupancy{role="inference",region="us-west-2"}[5m]) by (instance)
```
sam: linking the heatmap I made from 08:00-09:00: https://grafana.redwood/g/occupancy/heatmap?from=08:00&to=09:00 — you can see the canary spine dip.
jun: pulled runtime logs around kernel selection. getting a bunch of: `KernelSelector: no fast_gemm candidate for seq_len=1024 batch=1 -> using gemm_generic`. run snippet I used: `rg "KernelSelector" /var/log/runtime/* | tail -n 200`
sofia: that message explains occupancy drop — small batch sizes cause chosen kernel to be suboptimal on ampere devices. two paths: force a fast kernel for these shards or tweak batching heuristics to avoid batch=1.
maria: on KV side I see prefetch window shrinking after the refactor. suspect `kv_prefetch_delay_ms` default bumped down in config. checking commit history now.
alex: grabbed a short perf counter sample from one affected node: `SM_ACTIVE=24%`, `SM_EFF_UTIL=29%`, `dram_util=62%`, `power=120W`, `gpu_temp=79C` — contrasts with healthy node: `SM_ACTIVE=86%` etc.
perf-bot: microbench suggestion: run `runtime_bench --model llama-13b --batch=1,2,4,8 --seq=1024 --kernel-debug` and collect `kernel_choice.csv`. recommend sending output to #s3-perf-artifacts.
sam: I started a canary rollback but deploy-bot shows last canary deploy was `2026-03-17T09:12:04` -> image `registry.redwood/runtime:canary-20260317-7b9`. deploy-bot: `deploy-bot: canary deployment finished (09:12)`.
sofia: quick mitigation YAML to force kernel override per-model if we want to hotfix:```yaml
model:
  name: llama-13b
  kernel_policy:
    override: fast_gemm_v1
```
jun: I'll run the microbench now against the canary image and a pinned older image to compare kernel selection counts. assigning myself.
maria: I'll audit KV prefetch defaults and surface any config drift. pinging @infra for recent config pushes.
alex: action items: jun -> microbench + kernel_choice.csv; maria -> KV prefetch audit; sam -> correlation heatmap and logs; sofia -> prepare kernel override k8s patch if we need fast rollback. I'll keep thread open and update with results.
sam: noted, will upload heatmap + log tgz to the thread when ready.
perf-bot: scheduled perf-run ticket created: PRF-4821. ETA 2h.
deploy-bot: Reminder: rollback is a manual action — no automated rollback configured for kernel-selector refactor.
alex: thanks all. if anyone finds a quick config toggle to restore occupancy, post it here. otherwise we'll proceed with the microbench + patch plan. :thumbsup:
